title: IntegrationNode
description: A single integration record as returned by the Confida Integra northbound API (GET /api/v1/integrations and /integrations/{id}). Normalised across all sources (OpenShift, Proxmox, ...).

id.description: Deterministic fingerprint of the integration's core attributes (source, destination, data model, protocol, environment). Stable while those attributes are unchanged.

namespace.description: Originating namespace / project (OpenShift) or source reference (e.g. 'proxmox:node/vmid').

source_system.description: Name of the source system of the flow.

destination_system.description: Name of the destination system of the flow.

data_model_name.description: Data model(s); may be a semicolon-separated list.

data_model_schema_url.description: Optional URL to the data model schema.

protocol.description: Composed as 'source-interface → destination-interface', or a single interface when only one side is set.

node_type.description: Workload type marker; 'integration' for integration records.

environment.description: Deployment environment. The API accepts the short forms (prod/dev/test/qa) as synonyms in filters.

gdpr_basis.description: Legal basis for GDPR processing (free text).

source.description: Discovery source. New source values may be added over time (additive, non-breaking).

last_seen.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the integration was last observed.

missing_since.description: ISO-8601 timestamp from which no configured source has observed this integration. Empty (or absent) when it was seen in the most recent successful collection. Orthogonal to `status`: an integration can be both deprecated and no longer observed.

extra.description: Source-specific and supplementary fields. Consumers should treat unknown keys as additive.
